title: Turnaround (TAT)
seo_description: Turnaround time (TAT) tracking for diagnostic labs: a target for every case, live elapsed time, at-risk alerts, delay reasons, and on-time rate.

fields.hero_title: Catch turnaround delays before the doctor calls
fields.hero_lead: Every case carries a target time. Labora shows elapsed time against that target live, highlights what is at risk, and alerts the right people the moment a report runs late.
fields.features:
Target time for every case
Elapsed vs. target, live
At-risk and overshoot views
Automatic alerts when a target is missed
A reason logged for every delay
On-time delivery rate at a glance

steps.title: Set targets
steps.text: Give each test or test group its own target, with a separate one for urgent priority.

steps.title: Watch the clock
steps.text: Green is on time, amber is at risk, red is past target, so the team knows what to do next.

steps.title: Review weekly
steps.text: See the on-time rate and the most common delay reasons, by test and by center.

fields.cta_title: See turnaround tracking with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
